manifest_description.message: Connect and control local Pi-hole instances from your browser.

option_about_copy_debug.message: Paste the following debug information into the issue:

options_headline_additional_info.message: Enter the Pi-hole address and web interface password, then save the connection explicitly.

options_client_group_load_error.message: Client groups could not be loaded. Save a working Pi-hole connection first.

options_hide_group_selector_in_popup.message: Hide the client-group selector in the popup

options_hide_group_list_actions_in_popup.message: Hide group-specific whitelist and blacklist actions in the popup

options_badge_uses_selected_group.message: Determine the toolbar badge's blocking status from the selected client group

options_group_pause_time_hint.message: Used by the three orange client-group buttons. Minimum: 10 seconds

options_temporary_allow_time_hint.message: Used by the three orange domain buttons for the selected client group. Minimum: 10 seconds

options_reload_after_disable.message: Reload the current tab after disabling global or group blocking

options_reload_after_white_list.message: Reload the current tab after allowing a domain

options_save_error.message: Pi-hole connection settings could not be saved.

options_url_invalid_warning.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

options_disable_list_feature.message: Hide global whitelist and blacklist actions in the popup

options_data_management_info.message: Backups exclude Pi-hole passwords by default. Imports are validated and previewed before they are applied.

options_backup_include_credentials.message: Include Pi-hole passwords in the exported file

options_backup_import_select.message: Select a Wormhole Connector settings file

options_backup_import_preview.message: Import preview: $connections$ connection(s), $preferences$ preference(s), credentials included: $credentials$

options_backup_error.message: The settings file could not be processed.

options_safe_sync.message: Synchronize safe settings through the browser account

options_safe_sync_hint.message: Opt-in only. Pi-hole passwords and session IDs are never synchronized.

popup_global_error.message: Global Pi-hole blocking state could not be changed. Already changed instances were restored where possible.

popup_group_warning.message: The selected client group is disabled completely and enabled again automatically when the timer expires.

popup_group_error.message: The selected client group could not be changed.

option_multiple_connections.message: Mutations across multiple Pi-hole instances are preflighted and rolled back where possible if one target fails.

popup_domain_general_actions.message: Permanent rule for all client groups

popup_domain_status_unknown.message: Status unknown or mixed across instances

popup_domain_action_error.message: The domain action failed. Already changed instances were restored where possible.
